messages:
Maya: quick sync — onboarding telemetry is flaky, playbook automation skipping steps for some accounts. noticed ~12% of new signups never hit "engaged" stage in SF after 14 days. can we triage?

Jamal: ugh yeah saw that on Friday. dashboard: https://redwood.app/dashboards/onboard-stage-gap (perm: cs-team)
Jamal: initial smell = mismatch between onboarding_stage and onboarding_stage__c fields (old vs new mapping)

Sophia: I can own the cleanup. do we have a safe backfill plan? want to avoid triggering duplicate playbook emails.

Leo: SQL sample from a quick slice I ran:
```
SELECT account_id, onboarding_started_at, onboarding_stage, onboarding_stage__c
FROM prod.salesforce.accounts
WHERE onboarding_started_at >= '2025-11-01'
AND (onboarding_stage IS NULL OR onboarding_stage != onboarding_stage__c)
LIMIT 200
```

Leo: result: ~47 accounts with mismatched tags, most missing the new enum value that our playbook hook expects ("engaged").

Arjun: context: automation triggers are based on the webhook payload field `onboarding_status.current_phase` sent from SFDC -> webhook service -> playbook-runner. SFDC outbound mapping still points at old field `onboarding_stage` for some records.

Arjun: suggested flow:
1) Add a non-invasive backfill job to copy onboarding_stage -> onboarding_stage__c where __c is null.
2) Enqueue a playbook re-evaluation API for affected account_ids (no emails, dry-run tag first).
3) Monitor healthscore delta and manual check 10% sample.

Maya: that sounds good. Sophia, can you run step 1 with Leo on infra? Jamal can help with the dry-run flag logic in playbook-runner.

Sophia: yep — can do. ETA to run backfill in staging: tomorrow morning. production run Thu 03:00 UTC if no issues.

Jamal: playbook-runner change is trivial: add `retrigger_mode=dry_run|apply` param. I'll add `dry_run=true` by default for the backfill pass.

Leo: small snippet for the re-trigger POST (so ops can review):
```json
{
  "account_id": "<id>",
  "retrigger_mode": "dry_run",
  "reason": "onboarding-field-backfill-2026-03"
}
```

Sophia: FYI we should also capture a feedback marker that an account was re-evaluated so renewals team doesn't get duplicate outreach. maybe `cs_recalc_history` array or a last_recalc_at timestamp.

Arjun: agree. playbook-runner will add `last_recalc_at` to account metadata and emit event `cs.onboarding.recalc` to Kafka. that feeds the healthscore service to recalc.

Maya: what about CRM hygiene ongoing? can we prevent regressions?

Jamal: propose a nightly validation job that writes anomalies to a `cs_data_issues` table and pings #customer-success with a compact digest (max 10 items). also add a salesman-friendly check in the onboarding flow to require new enum pick.

Sophia: also want a one-off to merge legacy onboarding tags in SF mapping and add an inbound validation rule so UI can't save the old value. will coordinate with product.

Maya: owners: Sophia (backfill + SF rule), Leo (SQL and infra runbook), Jamal (playbook-runner dry_run + slack digest), Arjun (events + healthscore recalc).

Maya: timeline recap: staging backfill TOMORROW 09:00 PT, prod backfill THU 03:00 UTC, dry-run first, monitor 24h, then apply if green.

Leo: adding runbook checklist here:
- snapshot accounts table (export)
- run backfill in staging
- enqueue dry_run re-evals (47 accounts)
- validate no outbound emails triggered
- inspect healthscore and playbook decision logs
- proceed to prod window

playbook-bot: queued 47 re-eval jobs (mode: dry_run). job-id: pb-20260320-47

Sophia: :thumbsup: saw the bot. will check logs in 20m.

Jamal: quick note for renewals: we'll add a flag `recently_recalculated_by_cs` to suppress renewal nudges for 7 days to avoid churn in outreach.

Maya: perfect. can someone add the action items to the CS project board? (assigning Sophia & Jamal)

Sophia: done — board card: "onboarding telemetry backfill + playbook re-eval" with links to runbook and PRs.

Leo: PRs: infra: https://github.com/redwood/inference-runner/pull/612, sql migration gist: https://gist.github.com/leo/2f3b

Maya: thanks all. we'll reconvene Fri 10:00 PT if prod apply happened. if any blocker ping me directly.

Arjun: noted. will emit `cs.onboarding.recalc` events to the topic and add a quick Grafana chart for post-recalc healthscore delta.

Maya: closing loop — :white_check_mark:
